notes.subject: על הרע כפים להיטיב
notes.rationale: Famously tangled: 'concerning evil, both hands are ready to do it well (thoroughly)' — rendered literally rather than KJV's reordered 'do evil with both hands earnestly'.

notes.subject: בשלום
notes.rationale: שלום here is not 'peace' but a requital/bribe for the judge, rendered 'sakim mani'.

notes.subject: שאל
notes.rationale: 'Asks' — understood by most as demanding a bribe, matching the judge in the parallel clause.

translation: Long wokim olgeta samting nogut, tupela han bilong ol i redi olgeta; hetman i askim olkia, na man i skelim i wet long sakim mani; na bikman tru, em yet i tokaut olgeta laik nogut bilong bel bilong en; na olgeta ol i tanimim pinis olgeta tok.

tokens.gloss: na ol i tanimim olgeta tok
